reviewScope.summary: Campaign M01 visual and scoped presentation-language revision; draft, not a full authoring-source upgrade.
evidence: Reviewed committed M01: 23 units, 152 exercise prompts and their response modes; inspected setup and troubleshooting choices, hints and feedback in detail. The remaining individual exercise feedback and browser visual review are unfinished.

21 lesson-bound examples (seven selectable), plus 72 exact-string prose revisions scoped to M01. Corrected misleading hidden-file-extension example and clarified Python version requirements, file execution, error investigation and Git workflow. Original code, expected outputs, exercise identifiers, evaluators, hashes and progression remain unchanged.

Initial hosted run 46071603686: all three E2E shards passed; unit stage stopped on LessonView.tsx formatting. Replaced nested JSX conditional with a typed helper; new exact-source binding regression test. Fresh hosted checks required.

Repository history, PRs #85 and #88, and their available artifact listings contain shipped exports and release records, not the full pinned producer source. The supplied earlier authoring snapshot has three modules and does not match the seven-module pin. No source pin changed. The exact-text presentation layer avoids breaking regeneration and does not reinterpret evaluator inputs.

adversarialFindings.description: Abstract code, terminal location, file versions and error timing are hard to distinguish in prose.
adversarialFindings.resolution: Use existing visual renderer for contextual diagrams and selectable examples.

adversarialFindings.description: The external producer snapshot cannot be reproduced from available GitHub resources alone.
adversarialFindings.resolution: Keep generated artifacts intact, use an exact-source presentation-only overlay, and retain this as a draft rather than claim a complete canonical revision.

adversarialFindings.description: Presentation overrides could drift or change exercise semantics.
adversarialFindings.resolution: Exact original-string keys, M01-only context, original exercise objects untouched; added binding regression test. The overlay falls back to original text if the source changes.

adversarialFindings.description: Initial release unit stage failed formatting.
adversarialFindings.resolution: Simplify the conditional and run the existing hosted checks again; do not claim PASS until observed.

retrospective.summary: Proceed to hosted validation of this scoped draft. Full review remains outstanding and this is not a production release authorization.
